package.name: carolus_ros2
package.description: ROS2 wrapper around carolus_core (libuvgs_astrobee's ROS-free P4P/beacon detection library, extracted 2026-08-18). Proof that the extraction makes the target middleware a later choice: this package adds no new algorithm code, only rclcpp subscriptions/publishers and message conversion around the same detection methods the ROS1 node uses.
